lead.headline: Jefferson is out; McLaurin's hamstring makes Sunday 06:00 the check that matters
lead.deck: Addison is already in Jefferson's slot and re-projected to 14.8. The flex is now a questionable McLaurin over a questionable Coker, with Kamara as the last resort. Swift is cleared, so the Monangai card is finished.
lead.body: Justin Jefferson will not play. He missed all three practices and Minnesota ruled him out on Friday; Kevin O'Connell calls him day-to-day and says the team will not rush him. Jordan Addison went into his slot at 12:34, before the designation, and ESPN has since moved Addison from 11.6 to 14.8, so the lineup as set is the projection lineup. The new problem arrived in London. Terry McLaurin, the flex, was added to Washington's report on Friday with a hamstring, limited, and is questionable; his 13.1 has not moved. The cover, Jalen Coker at 13.0, is questionable too after a third limited day, and Dave Canales will not decide before Saturday. So nothing moves today. On Sunday, check Washington's inactives at 06:00: if McLaurin is out, Coker takes the flex, and because Coker plays last, Alvin Kamara can still replace him at 16:50. Marcus Mariota starts for Washington with Jayden Daniels ruled out. In Chicago, D'Andre Swift practised in full and has no designation, which ends the Monangai comparison. Josh Allen carries no designation and New England's top cornerback is out.

doFirst.note: Don't swap today: Coker is questionable as well and a tenth behind. Tomorrow afternoon's edition reads Saturday's news from London; a downgrade moves Coker in a day early.
